capabilities: Export the active .canvas file as a zip
Include markdown notes used in canvas nodes and follow note links
Include non-markdown attachments and group background images
Rewrite canvas paths and note links so the bundle stays connected
Generate unique names for duplicate filenames
extras: Desktop-only; the exported zip is always written to the vault root; missing or unresolved files are skipped; manual installation required (copy main.js and manifest.json).
problem: Sharing or backing up a canvas requires manually collecting every linked note, attachment, and asset, and exported links break when files are missing.
summary: Canvas export tool that bundles an Obsidian canvas with its linked notes, attachments, and assets into a portable zip archive.
